item.name: Get the personalized feed for the current user

request.name: Get the personalized feed for the current user

query.description: Indicate if you want a fresh feed

Get the current feed and issue a task to fully refresh it. Note that this feed response will not be the fully re-generated feed as it is asynchronously being generated. Please keep pooling this endpoint until all generated_at fields of the collections are updated.
Specifies whether to exclude content liked and saved by user from personalized content. Defaults to True.

response.name: Returns the personalized feed.
